protocol.source_text: diacetoxypalladium (20.76 mg, 0.09 mmol) was added to 5-bromopyridin-3-amine (160 mg, 0.92 mmol), morpholine (4028 µl, 46.24 mmol) (9,9-dimethyl-9H-xanthene-4,5-diyl)bis(diphenylphosphine) (64.2 mg, 0.11 mmol) and cesium carbonate (603 mg, 1.85 mmol). The resulting suspension was stirred at 150 °C for 30 minutes in a microwave. Reaction very messy but some product is visible. Reaction abandoned.
